appraisal.reasoning: No financials, listings, reviews, or confirmation the named laundromat exists were found (2020 Murray Ave is a restaurant), so revenue, SDE, staffing, and value are inferred from the 42-machine attended wash-and-fold plus student-delivery description, 2011 ownership, Squirrel Hill location, and typical Allegheny County asking prices starting near $120k for smaller automated shops. A going-concern asset sale on an SDE multiple would most likely land in the mid-$200ks. Confidence is very low due to the total lack of verifiable data.

I inferred ~$85k revenue and ~$40k SDE from typical small urban coin-ops and applied a ~4.4× SDE multiple, in line with the $100k–$500k asking range noted for similar Pennsylvania laundromats. Dense Bloomfield foot traffic supports that level while competition, unknown lease/equipment, and unattended-operation risks keep the figure a range-informed estimate only.
